feature: Native kinetic momentum scrolling with predominant-item alignment
source: Implemented from the user's written requirements; no reference site or extracted third-party interaction code.

files.momentum-scroll.js: Reusable native-scroll controller and pure geometry/spring helpers.
files.index.html: Six full-viewport photos for human flick and scrolling tests.
files.feed.css: Responsive photo feed and CSS proximity-snap fallback when JavaScript does not run.
files.photos.json: External photo URLs and successful HTTP verification.

integration: Give the container a fixed viewport height, overflow-y:auto, touch-action:pan-y pinch-zoom and scroll-behavior:auto.
Mark children data-scroll-item. With JavaScript enhanced, disable CSS scroll-snap-type so it cannot compete with the controller.
Import createMomentumScroll from momentum-scroll.js; call it with the scroll container. The returned controller has refresh() and destroy().

behavior.momentum: Native browser touch/trackpad inertia. Input is passive and never preventDefault'ed or multiplied; native physics determine velocity-sensitive travel.
behavior.handoff: Monitor actual scroll velocity. Start alignment only after speed remains below 40px/s for 100ms and input has been quiet for at least 160ms, with no active touch or pressed pointer.
behavior.selection: Maximum vertically visible pixel area; center-distance tie break. No direction-forced next item.
behavior.alignment: Start-align fitting items within scroll bounds. Oversized items covering the viewport remain freely readable.
behavior.easing: Analytic critically damped spring, seeded with measured low native velocity. No artificial fling added.
behavior.interruption: New wheel, touch, pointer or scroll-key input cancels spring immediately and restores native control.
behavior.accessibility: Native keyboard scrolling, pinch zoom and reduced-motion immediate final alignment after settling. scroll-snap-stop:normal allows multi-item travel.

photos: Six original Unsplash image URLs, external hosting required; no external JavaScript libraries.

validation.automated: 7 tests passed: predominant visibility, fit/bounds/oversize, velocity-continuous spring, held touch, high-velocity multi-item travel, immediate interruption, reduced motion.
validation.photo_requests: All six returned HTTP 200 with image/jpeg content.
validation.live_browser: Passed live desktop checks: loaded all six photos; short wheel input returned to the predominantly visible photo; larger scroll aligned photo 2 at scrollTop 757; long scroll crossed multiple items and aligned final photo at 3785; Home and Page Down worked and settled exactly at 0 and 757. Enhanced mode disables competing CSS snapping.
validation.physical_devices: Real iOS/Android flick and hardware trackpad feel require human testing; native behavior varies by browser and operating system.
validation.github_readback: All seven uploaded files matched committed contents.
